newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Tractebel in Thai power plant deal.
newsitem.headline: Tractebel in Thai power plant deal.

text.p: Belgian energy holding company Tractebel SA said on Monday its Southern Power Co joint venture signed an agreement with the Electricity Generating Authority of Thailand on the building of a power plant in the province of Surathani, southern Thailand.
Southern Power is 45 percent owned by Tractebel's subsidiary Powerfin SA, 45 percent by Southern Palm Oil Industry (1993) Co Ltd and 10 percent by Surat Energy Co.
The 44 megawatt plant will deliver 42 megawatt to Thailand's national grid, and two megawatt and 33 tonnes of steam per hour to the neighbouring Southern Palm Oil Industry.
The plant will use biomass waste from crude palm oil production as fuel, Tractebel said in a statement.

Southern Power is currently securing tax privileges from the Thai Board of Investment. The project is supported by the European Community Cogeneration Programme because of its use of European technology.
